steps.text: 11:30 A.M. \ Overcast
Countryside - Rhodes Island Chief Engineer's Office

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What are you doing this time?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit, you think I could see the Doctor for a bit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Has it been too long since you pranked {@nickname}? Feeling antsy?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh come on! I'm really a very caring person.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Last time you called yourself a caring person, you set up a facility to broadcast 'Closure's Midnight Video Market' at twelve o'clock for three months straight.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We still have no way to turn the volume down.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay okay, I admit it! I want to go tease the Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Not to mention {@nickname}'s memory loss. I can't say for sure if the Doctor even knows who you are.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Slept too much and turned stupid, huh? That's sad. I'll have to bring the Doctor some snacks as a little cheer-up gift.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whatever. Just try not to make a bad impression.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Warfarin went bad enough. Add in the Doctor's misconceptions about vampires and the Kazdel matter will have to be postponed. Indefinitely.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is an opportunity to rehabilitate yourself in the eyes of the people. Seize it well.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Do I really need rehabilitating?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After the time you set the climate control system to 36 degrees, yes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That was a power outage in the machine shop.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We found your fingerprints on the console.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It was a power outage in the machine shop!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You hacked the surveillance system and deleted the recording, but the console served as a biological backup. I have thirteen tissue samples from thirteen different instances.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm sorry it's my bad that envoy is such an arrogant prick I just want to rub his nose in it sorry.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Anyway, the welcome party. Dr. {@nickname}'s welcome back party. We're not throwing one?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Afraid not. Circumstances such as they are.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, why you gotta be like that, Kal'tsit? This is the Doctor we're talking about, the Doctor with amensia. We gotta create an atmosphere of warmth and camaraderie.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you always look at the Doctor so?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Maybe... I've never been that close to the Doctor. But didn't you just say this is the perfect time to make a good impression?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Closure, let's talk about something else.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmph. If you're not going, I'll go myself. I don't care what you do.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did I hear we're going to Lungmen? I think that was on the schedule.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And we can operate freely?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lungmen has become quite dangerous.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Really? Lungmen? I thought that place was all about law and order.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's the closest city to Chernobog. That should be pretty self-explanatory.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So why are we going?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because it's the closest city to Chernobog.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I think you're hiding something...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No. I said everything there is to be said in the last meeting. Right about the time you were slumped back in your chair, wearing an eye mask, fast asleep.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What can I say? Keeping this operation well maintained is tiring work.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I never said I blamed you. Without you, Rhodes Island wouldn't even get off the ground.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I still want to do away with your suspicions... What is it you called me in for, exactly?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What? I can't just call up an old friend?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll be in my lab.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey! Wait! Okay... we have a power outage down two corridors in sector three.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Can you come look at the cables with me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just send an engineer down there. Is it a problem with the power supply cables?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Or the two of us could go look ourselves.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whenever I ask you for an inspection, you always delegate it to another operator.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: My sense of responsibility as Chief Engineer of Rhodes Island has suddenly awakened! Let's go!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Come on, keep up with me...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is Heavyrain.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh. Heavyrain?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Hello, Miss Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What a good little girl! Look, Kal'tsit, look how much more likable she is than you!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Heavyrain, let me see your monitor.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: This one...? On my left arm here?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes. Be careful not to touch the needle.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Numbers look good. Your hemoglobin is up. You're recovering well.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Thank you, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No thanks necessary. Just doing my job. You don't thank people for that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You know the way back, Heavyrain?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then you show yourself out. Closure and I have something to take care of.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: But I'm a guard. If I go, will you be okay, Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You may be mistaken, Heavyrain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I asked you to come with us just to give you a the layout of the ship. You may not come here often in the future.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't need protection.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Then, excuse me. Goodbye, Miss Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, bye.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Did you hear that, Kal'tsit? She called me 'Miss!' Oh what a good little girl...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She really seemed to want to help you out. And you sent her away like that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Every operator has to find her own place in the world, just like me. Having her waste time with things she's not good at doesn't help anybody.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Would it kill you to talk like a human being every once in a while?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Heavyrain was in the Sargon military.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before she can establish interpersonal relationships, she needs to find a proper position for herself and integrate into Rhodes Island. That requires both support and tolerance, as well as her own self-awareness.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah yeah, your lectures make my head hurt.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She another one of your strays you brought home?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You kind of have a talent for picking up new pets, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How many are we up to now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's one of the steps in the 'Acquisition and Cultivation Procedures for Infected Personnel.'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hold on... Last month, you had a solid 72-hour surgical procedure. Was that her you were operating on?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The surgical team went through like eight or nine shifts, but you didn't sleep for three days?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At least she recovered quickly.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Tell me, Kal'tsit, do you drug yourself?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I refuse to answer that question.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If I don't ask, you'll never say, will you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's the point of discussing this?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're too hard on yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can handle it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dark!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Should we be using backup power?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can't see?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm a vampire, of course I can see.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So can I.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: All right then, on we go.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now I know what I just said, but did I step on something?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Augh! Wh- what is this!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nothing to get all upset about...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is that... a gachapon machine? What's it doing here?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh. 'Furry Friends Collection. 12 different furry friends to...' Wow, secret level! Awesome!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Clo-sure!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's been a long time since I worked in a dark pipeline like this. I really missed it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And Rhodes Island wasn't nearly this big back then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Spanner, please!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thanks, Mon3tr!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can't reach it. Can you give me a boost so I can fix the cable?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oof... This whole area has been totally cut off from the power supply. We can start troubleshooting.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kal'tsit, do you think it was a mistake to go to Chernobog and rescue the Doctor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was certainly unwise to enter Chernobog at that time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya was very firm in her decision. No one could sway her. And you know how the elite operators are.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It only happened because you abstained.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm starting to think this was some kind of test of Amiya?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Test? No, not a test. Or rather if it was a test, it wasn't me administering it. It was the situation she found herself in.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But as firmly as she believed in that decision, I could only support her... Though I certainly didn't have to make her feel like it would all go smoothly.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Her choice is her choice.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well said. But you're the one who has to deal with the consequences. Aren't you tired...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nobody gets it all right from beginning to end, Closure. Not even me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But we made it through the darkness. Now we just wait for the light at the end of the tunnel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Also, that second cable right above your head is about to fall.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey hey hey! Hold me steady! If the three-pin power connector drops, that's the end of both of us.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay, hold up, I'm laying out the wire.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you just stuff two whole sets of wires in behind them?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Shhh! I must feel the thrum of the electricity in my own heart, to achieve peace and balance with the current.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I advise you to mull over what you just said.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But, Kal'tsit... Oh, should be good. Try the switch.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I was saying, regardless of what kind of riddle you were just playing at, if you're walking in the dark, you need some kind of light, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Aren't we fixing the lights right now?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, there we go.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Closure.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Why are you asking me about these things?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Because if I don't ask, you don't tell.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You let it all well up inside you until you go crazy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So my answers don't even matter to you?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I think all these things you told me are reeeeeeaaally important, to you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So yeah it's not that important what you say... but it's really super important that you say it, and I hear it with my own two ears.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What a waste of time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Next time I'll just hand you the written report.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But then you wouldn't come with me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Says who?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As long as you really have some lights that need fixing.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Promise?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How is it I always end up making some strange, inexplicable deal with you?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's what an engineer does!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Here, Kal'tsit, take a look at this light bulb.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's very clear?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, clear!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If only you were like this all the time, I'd be a lot less tense.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If only...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Woah! Shut up! Don't say it!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just be quiet... and enjoy this little light together.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It really is a nice, gentle light.
